description: MECHANISM: only a handler's BODY is dispatch-dependent — its HEAD arguments are ordinary expressions, evaluated where the handler is registered, and are judged in the enclosing context (issue #1155). `every repcount [ … ]` at top level reads a turn that does not exist at registration time, so it is a fault; `repeat 2 [ every repcount [ … ] ]` is clean, which the unit suite pins. Without this fixture the head/body split is asserted by nothing in the corpus: a rule that skipped the entire `ProfileStatement` — head arguments included — leaves all 1013 other fixtures green.
